reviews.comment: Professor Tatevik definitely wants you to learn as she is very passionate and smart, but she teaches in a very difficult way to understand. You had to have paid attention in past ecmt classes. Sometimes she moves on too fast and makes many examples that confuse you. Hard quizzes. Great person overall, but difficult class. Wish it was more R

The course is amazing if you put in the work. Teaching feels messy & her way of framing test ques makes it seem more complicated than it is. The course has both R programming and math so get ready to juggle a few things. I would recommend taking up an R course on datacamp before (this is also graded). Overall sentiment was that this class is hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It is clear the professor is very knowledgeable on the material, but she lacks the skills needed to help students learn on a more fundamental level. She shows little to no empathy towards the class when the average is lower than she expected and she is no help when you go to office hours. There was not one point where I wasn't lost this semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor is exceptional: knowledgeable, clear in communication, prioritizes student understanding over syllabus coverage. One of the best I've had!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: She is a kind and caring professor and seems to genuinely want the best for her students. Lectures are often fast-paced and confusing; you can either write down everything or try to follow and understand but you probably can't do both. She provided old tests to practice with that were very similar to the two exams which helped a ton.

Teaches as if everyone already knows what she is talking about. Trust me, she's smart she just doesn't know how to teach well. R is used for HW but the code bootcamp won't help, honestly, the coding portion and the theory should be separate courses. Gives past exams that are extremely helpful for midterm and final but you dont cover them in notes.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things
